context: ## Hydrogen 2026-10

Hydrogen `2026-10` works in any framework that runs server code, such as Next.js, React Router, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, or SolidStart. - **Setup:** To add Hydrogen to an existing project, run `npx @shopify/hydrogen@latest setup` in the folder that contains `package.json`. The command installs `@shopify/hydrogen` and copies Hydrogen's skills into `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`. Then follow the `hydrogen-setup` skill to wire Hydrogen into the app. Follow [Add Hydrogen to an existing project](https://shopify.dev/docs/storef

- **Skills:** Before you write code for a feature, read the skill for that feature, such as `hydrogen-cart-ui` for a cart UI. If a project on Hydrogen `2026-10` is missing the skills, run `npx @shopify/hydrogen skills sync`. To update a project on Hydrogen `2026-10`, update `@shopify/hydrogen` to the latest `2026.10` release, and then run `npx @shopify/hydrogen skills sync`.
